titles.romaji: Ishi no Youna Jikan no Melody
titles.native: 石のような時間のメロディ

description:
Unable to bear the death of his beloved dog, the old man brings it back to life. His dog becomes a monster and swallows him. Inside, the old man is forced to face his memories and the meaning of his life.

Graduate Work 2024, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation.

(Source: Geidai Animation)
